dashboard.label: Banking & FinTech SOC — Threat Detection & Fraud Monitoring
dashboard.description: Real-Time Open Banking API (HTTP/JSON) & Core Payment Switch (TCP/ISO 8583) Security Operations Center

panel.title: Scenario 2: BOLA / IDOR Unauthorized Account Scrapes
Scenario 1 Detection: Credential Stuffing to Account Takeover (ATO) & Illicit Wire Chain

search.query: index=fintech_soc (event_type="AUTH_FAIL" OR event_type="AUTH_SUCCESS" OR event_type="BENEFICIARY_ADDED" OR event_type="TRANSACTION_INITIATED") | stats count(eval(event_type="AUTH_FAIL")) as Failed_Logins, count(eval(event_type="AUTH_SUCCESS")) as Successful_Logins, values(beneficiary_account) as Added_Mule_Beneficiary, max(transaction_amount) as Max_Transfer_USD, values(user_id) as Targeted_Users by client_ip | where Failed_Logins >= 10 OR isnotnull(Added_Mule_Beneficiary) | sort - Failed_Logins

panel.title: ISO 8583 Payment Switch Response Code Distribution (DE 39)

search.query: index=fintech_soc component="ISO8583_CORE_SWITCH" | eval Response_Status=case( iso_response_code=="00", "00 - Approved", iso_response_code=="51", "51 - Insufficient Funds (Velocity Drain)", iso_response_code=="05", "05 - Do Not Honor (Frozen Account)", 1==1, iso_response_code) | stats count by Response_Status

panel.title: Scenario 2 Detection: OWASP API1 Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) Enumeration

search.query: index=fintech_soc event_type="ACCOUNT_BALANCE_QUERY" | stats count as Total_Queries, dc(target_account) as Distinct_Accounts_Accessed, count(eval(bola_indicator="true")) as Unauthorized_BOLA_Hits, values(authenticated_account) as Own_Account by user_id, client_ip, user_agent | where Distinct_Accounts_Accessed > 1 OR Unauthorized_BOLA_Hits > 0 | sort - Unauthorized_BOLA_Hits

panel.title: Scenario 3 Detection: AML Structuring ("Smurfing") & Velocity Bypass (5-Min Window)

search.query: index=fintech_soc event_type="TRANSACTION_INITIATED" | bin _time span=5m | stats count as Tx_Count, sum(transaction_amount) as Cumulative_Attempted_USD, sum(eval(if(iso_response_code="00", transaction_amount, 0))) as Approved_Drained_USD, max(transaction_amount) as Max_Single_Tx_USD, values(static_aml_flag) as Static_CTR_Flag, values(iso_response_code) as Switch_DE39_Codes by user_id, src_account, dst_account, client_ip | where Tx_Count >= 5 AND Max_Single_Tx_USD < 1000 AND Cumulative_Attempted_USD >= 10000

panel.title: Northbound HTTP API to Southbound ISO 8583 Core Switch Protocol Correlation (By Trace ID)

search.query: index=fintech_soc trace_id="ATK*" | stats values(component) as Layers_Traversed, values(event_type) as Events, values(client_ip) as Attacker_IP, values(endpoint) as HTTP_Endpoint, values(iso_mti_req) as ISO_Req_MTI, values(iso_mti_resp) as ISO_Resp_MTI, values(transaction_amount) as Amount_USD, values(iso_response_code) as DE39_Code by trace_id | sort trace_id
